blocks.text: Real Russian sentences that use what the lesson teaches. Type the missing word, or pick it, until it turns green.

These are real sentences: from Tatoeba (tatoeba.org, CC BY 2.0 FR), with their English translations, and from the public-domain Russian books in this library, with author and title. Each blank is the word the sentence really has; the word in brackets is its dictionary form.

exercises.q: If your shirt is tucked into your jeans, you should wear a belt.
exercises.ru: ___ рубашка заправляется в джинсы, следует надевать ремень.
exercises.why: «First type: "если" clauses … being statements of direct fact, they are expressed by the indicative mood. Second type: "если бы" clauses … the conditions are either improbable or downright contrary to existing fact.» — DLI, Lesson 90. Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).
